name: MonarchSegmentedControl
title: SegmentedControl
summary: A single choice among two to five short options: a muted track with a raised white pill under the chosen segment.
whenToUse: For switching between a few views or filters of the same content, such as Day, Week and Month, or List and Board.
whenNotToUse: For more than five options, or options with descriptions, use MonarchRadioRow or MonarchRadioCardGroup. For navigation between screens use Material 3 tabs. For an option that is on or off use MonarchSwitchRow.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSegmentedControl(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchSegmentedControlSize = MonarchSegmentedControlSize.Md, fillWidth: Boolean = false, content: @Composable MonarchSegmentedControlScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchSegmentedControl(options: List<String>, selectedIndex: Int, onSelect: (Int) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchSegmentedControlSize = MonarchSegmentedControlSize.Md, fillWidth: Boolean = false, disabledIndices: Set<Int> = emptySet())

@Composable fun MonarchSegmentedControlScope.Segment(selected: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, count: Int? = null, suffix: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, label: @Composable () -> Unit)
enum class MonarchSegmentedControlSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: fillWidth
options.description: Gives every segment an equal share of the width.

options.name: onClick
options.description: Called when the segment is chosen.

options.name: icon
options.description: A decorative 16dp icon before the label.

options.name: count
options.description: A number in a small pill after the label.

options.name: suffix
options.description: Short success-coloured text after the label.

options.name: disabledIndices
options.description: Options of the list overload that cannot be chosen.

states.name: selected
states.description: The raised surface pill with the subtle border and default text.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The disabled text colour; taps are ignored.

appearance: A muted track with 8dp corners and 2dp padding; the chosen segment is a surface-coloured pill with 6dp corners, a subtle border and the xs shadow. Text is 14sp medium, muted until chosen. The focus ring surrounds the pill.
platformNotes: Replaces SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow and SegmentedButton, whose outlined buttons with a check mark are not the Monarch look. Each segment is selectable with Role.RadioButton inside a selectableGroup, with a 48dp touch target around the pill (the track is 36dp visible at Md). Migrating: SegmentedButton(selected, onClick, shape = ..., label = { Text(t) }) becomes Segment(selected, onClick, label = t); drop shape, colors and border. The sizes sm, md and lg are the web sizes.
accessibility: Each segment has the RadioButton role and is read as selected or not selected.
Every segment reserves a touch target of at least 48dp by 48dp.
A disabled segment is read as disabled and ignores taps.
The chosen segment shows a check mark as well as a different fill.
Segments follow the layout direction, so the first option is at the right in right-to-left layouts.
edgeCases: Segments share the row width equally, so a long label wraps or is cut at large font sizes; keep labels to one or two words.
With more than five options the segments become too narrow on a phone.

examples.title: View switch
examples.template:
MonarchSegmentedControl(
    modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentDescription = {{label}} },
) {
    Segment(
        selected = layout == {{options.0.value}},
        onClick = { layout = {{options.0.value}} },
        label = {{options.0.label}},
        icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.List, contentDescription = null) },
    )
    Segment(
        selected = layout == {{options.1.value}},
        onClick = { layout = {{options.1.value}} },
        label = {{options.1.label}},
        icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Board, contentDescription = null) },
    )
    Segment(
        selected = layout == {{options.2.value}},
        onClick = { layout = {{options.2.value}} },
        label = {{options.2.label}},
        icon = { MonarchIcon(SampleIcons.Grid, contentDescription = null) },
    )
}
